pages.rationale: Exercises long unbroken code, wrapped code, diffs, terminal output, and nearby headings without reducing the text size.
Exercises aligned display mathematics, numbering, surrounding prose, and the transition into a piecewise equation.
Exercises a generated vector circuit, its caption and source note, figure placement, and adjacent explanatory prose.
Exercises a long technical table near its page boundary, repeated headers, column widths, and continuation behavior.
Exercises Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew, inline direction, font coverage, and dense appendix list composition.
